input.summary: The payments file landing/payments/keel_payments_20261110.csv (business day 2026-11-10, arrived 2026-11-11 03:47) breaks contract keel_payments v2.1. Column 'amount' has been renamed to 'payment_amount'. Under the contract this is a breaking change that needs 30 days' notice, and we received no notice. Harbor's ingest rejected the file (ingest_payments failed 3 times with SchemaMismatchError), so payments for 2026-11-10 are not loaded and the delinquency mart for that day is delayed. Action needed: please re-send the 2026-11-10 file as keel_payments_20261110_r1.csv with the contract column name 'amount' (all other columns and the trailer unchanged). Also confirm that later files will keep the v2.1 schema. Any planned schema change needs the 30-day notice to data-platform@harborlending.example. Please copy vendor-management@harborlending.example, since this is a contract breach.

input.summary: Keel Servicing renamed the column 'amount' to 'payment_amount' in the 2026-11-10 payments file without notice. That breaks contract v2.1. ingest_payments rejected the file, so nothing bad was loaded. dbt_build and publish did not run, which is why raw.payments and mart_delinquency are stale. The contract says not to adapt the pipeline to an unannounced breaking change, so I escalated to Keel and asked for a corrected re-send (_r1). Once it arrives, rerun ingest_payments for 2026-11-10. The alerts stay open until then.
